package.description: A blazing-fast CLI for creating LLM context from your entire codebase

en-US.description: A blazing-fast CLI for creating LLM context from your entire codebase
en-US.longDescription:
Context Builder generates a single, structured markdown file from any codebase directory.
The output is optimized for LLM consumption with relevance-based file ordering, AST-aware
code signatures via Tree-Sitter, automatic token budgeting with in-place file truncation,
and smart defaults.
en-US.name: Context Builder
